title: Correct Circle platform metric attribution and extend the SBI/Circle/Ripple/Coinbase/Binance economic network
decisions: Circle Q2 2026 19.5% daily weighted-average USDC-on-platform share and USD12.442B end balance belong to Circle's own platform as defined in note 1579, not Coinbase. Preserve prior misattributed records and append this correction.
Coinbase Q3 2026 average USDC held in Coinbase products is USD22B, up 49% YoY; keep it separate from Circle's Q2 Circle-platform metric.
Circle's Q2 distribution costs in connection with Coinbase agreements were USD324.6M Q2 and USD655.3M H1; model as Circle distribution expense, not as Coinbase balance or Circle platform share.

Record SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank's USD25M each Circle IPO investments and the 50/50 Circle SBI Japan K.K. JV. Circle consolidates the JV as a VIE; Q2 filing says no significant operating results through 2026-06-30.

Record SBI's historical approximately 9% Ripple shareholding as of 2025 and current 60% voting rights in SBI Ripple Asia as of 2026-03-31; do not assert current Ripple ownership percentage without updated disclosure.

Record Binance's USD100M Circle equity investment and five-year USDC promotion agreement, with monthly incentives tied to USDC held through Circle Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure. Do not infer Circle control of Binance or vice versa.
Treat SBI as an indirect Circle-Ripple corporate network hub, not a direct Circle-Ripple partnership. Treat Coinbase as a common distributor of USDC and RLUSD.

Keep stablecoin balances, distribution costs, equity investments and reserve yields as institutional context only. No XRP prediction feature admitted without route-level data and out-of-sample validation.
rationale: Circle's SEC Q2 10-Q note 1579 explicitly defines USDC on platform as Circle's own platform. This corrects a material metric-scope misattribution.
Coinbase's official Q3 earnings release supplies the separate USD22B average USDC balance and its company-reported share-of-economics claim.
Circle's SEC 8-K establishes a direct Binance equity and five-year commercial relationship.
SBI official and SEC sources establish separate direct financial relationships with Circle and Ripple; shared XRPL use does not prove direct issuer partnership.
next_action: Ingest Circle Q3 2026 results scheduled 2026-11-04 08:00 ET; reconcile Circle SBI Japan operating results, reserve yield, USDC supply, Coinbase/Binance distribution balances and costs. Continue Binance XRP reserve-wallet crosswalk and native-XRP route classification.
